title: Answer: actual occasions of experience, with creativity as the ultimate

statements.text: What is fundamental is actual occasions, momentary drops of experience, with creativity, the principle by which the many become one, as the ultimate. Eternal objects, pure potentials, are what occasions realize, and nothing exists apart from the experiences of subjects.

sources.quote: these actual entities are drops of experience, complex and interdependent
The many become one, and are increased by one.
